metadataRaw.title: How to Relieve Lower Back and Hip Pain in SECONDS
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows exercises to quickly relieve lower back and hip pain, even within 30 seconds!

These exercises work by stretching and strengthening the main muscles that cause pain in this area, including the glutes (buttocks), quadratus lumborum, and hip flexors. This helps provide both quick and long-lasting lower back and hip pain relief.

Each exercise works differently. They are performed in different positions and target different muscles.

To get the best results, go through them all and use the ones that provide the most relief.

Watch now and instantly fix lower back and hip pain!

Chapters: 
0:00 Intro
0:39 Seated Exercise
3:01 Bed/Floor Exercise
5:02 Standing Exercise
6:51 Advanced Exercise
8:50 Strengthening Exercise
